plain: A model trained to predict which answer people (or an AI labeller) would prefer, used as the judge during training.
eli5: A robot taster that learned what the real tasters like.
technical: A learned scalar scorer r(x, y), typically fit to pairwise preferences with a Bradley–Terry loss; Bai et al. (2022) call it a preference model, and in Constitutional AI its harmlessness comparisons come from AI feedback. It is a proxy judge; optimising hard against it exploits its errors (Gao et al. 2022).
